provisions_read: ZR Appendix F (MIH areas and former IH designated areas) (E4)
ZR 27-133 (MIH areas listed in Appendix F) (snapshot zr-27-133)
exceptions_considered: UAP developments are by definition outside MIH areas (ZR 12-10 (b)) - route available here.
An affordable housing regulatory agreement (ZR 12-10 (c)) is available independent of MIH mapping.
'Qualifying residential site' (ZR 12-10) is R1-R5 only and does not apply to this R6B lot.
meaning_and_applicability.reading: The whole lot outline (MapPLUTO 26v2, EPSG:2263) intersects no nycmih polygon (E2) and no nyih polygon (E3); the nearest MIH area is 5,925 ft away and the nearest former-IH area 17,618 ft away, far outside any map tolerance, so the lot is outside every MIH area and every former IH designated area. Because the lot is outside every MIH area, the ZR 27-131 MIH mandatory set-aside is not triggered by mapping. Being outside an MIH area does NOT by itself lower the R6B 'qualifying' figures: the higher ZR 23-22 (2.40 FAR) and ZR 23-432 (45/65 ft) columns are keyed to a zoning lot containing qualifying affordable or senior housing, which remains reachable through a UAP development (12-10 (b)) or a regulatory agreement (12-10 (c)). Being outside a former IH designated area means the older voluntary-IH FAR bonus does not apply. The membership facts are answered from the primary DCP layers; the downstream affordable-pathway reading is an unreviewed draft (ADR-007).
